name: Reveling Fool
summary: A jester's mask and costume give you a new identity that can get away with small offences against the high-born, and Hideous Laughter is free once per Long Rest.

benefits.name: Fool's Mask
benefits.summary: In a jovial mask and a fool's, jester's or clown's costume you take on a new identity and can get away with minor transgressions against people of rank or authority.
benefits.text: While you wear a jovial mask and a fool's, jester's or clown's costume you take on a new identity that hides your own. In that guise you can get away with minor transgressions against people in positions of authority or station.

benefits.name: Jester's Repartee
benefits.summary: Hideous Laughter always prepared; cast it once per Long Rest without a slot or Material components (Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma).
benefits.text: You always have the Hideous Laughter spell prepared. You can cast it once without Material components or a spell slot, regaining that use when you finish a Long Rest, and you can also cast it using any spell slots you have. Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for it (choose when you take this feat).
